purpose: Render the shopping cart page (server-rendered HTML), including the empty-cart state and per-line remove/move links.

success.bodySignal: Non-empty: lines with data-href="/shoppingcart/deletecartitem?cartItemId=<id>" and ".../moveitembetweencartandwishlist?cartItemId=<id>&cartType=ShoppingCart&isCartPage=True" plus inputs itemquantity<id>. Empty: text "Your Shopping Cart is empty!" (data-empty-text attribute is always present, so do not match on it alone).

purpose: Remove one line from the cart by its cart item id.

query.name: cartItemId
query.description: Cart line id (not product id), taken from the /cart HTML. Ids are global counters, not 1..n.

contentType: none (empty body; send Content-Length: 0, e.g. curl -d '')

success.bodySignal: JSON {success:true, message:"The product has been removed.", cartItemCount:<n>, cartHtml, totalsHtml, displayCheckoutButtons}. After the last line cartItemCount is 0.

failure.bodySignal: Unknown id, already-removed id, or id owned by another visitor: JSON {success:false, displayCheckoutButtons, message:"An error occurred during the removal of the product."}. GET gives 404 HTML. Missing or non-numeric cartItemId gives 502 Bad Gateway (HTML).

purpose: Move a cart line to the wishlist (the line leaves the cart and gets a NEW id on the wishlist).

query.name: cartItemId
query.description: Id of the line in the cart.

query.name: cartType
query.description: Source list of the line: ShoppingCart (move to wishlist).

query.name: isCartPage
query.description: UI flag; the UI always sends True. Effect of omitting it not tested.

contentType: none (empty body; send Content-Length: 0, otherwise IIS answers 411)

success.bodySignal: JSON {success:true, wasMoved:true, message:"The product has been added to your wishlist", cartHtml, totalsHtml, cartItemCount, displayCheckoutButtons}. Line now appears on /wishlist with a new cartItemId.

failure.bodySignal: Unknown id: JSON {success:false, message:"Product could not be added to the shopping cart."} (wording is misleading). POST with no Content-Length: 411 HTML. GET: 404 HTML. Missing cartItemId: 502 HTML.

purpose: Move a wishlist line back into the cart (the line gets a NEW id in the cart).

query.name: cartItemId
query.description: Id of the line on the wishlist, from the /wishlist HTML.

query.name: cartType
query.description: Source list of the line: Wishlist (move to cart).

query.name: isCartPage
query.description: UI flag; the UI sends True.

success.bodySignal: JSON {success:true, wasMoved:true, message:"The product has been added to your shopping cart", cartHtml, totalsHtml, cartItemCount, displayCheckoutButtons}.

failure.bodySignal: Unknown id: JSON {success:false, message:"Product could not be added to the shopping cart."}.

purpose: Render the wishlist page (server-rendered HTML) so wishlist line ids can be read and emptiness checked.

success.bodySignal: Lines carry data-href=".../moveitembetweencartandwishlist?cartItemId=<id>&cartType=Wishlist&isCartPage=True". Empty: "The wishlist is empty!" (data-empty-text also always present).
